blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Eagle Ridge. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Eagle Ridge, Coquitlam: 4 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 4 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 100% on only 4 listed, too few to read as a market type. By listings that is number 18 of 23 Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Eagle Ridge fell from 5 in June to 4 in October (−20.0%), and 12 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 1.1% of Coquitlam’s 378 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Eagle Ridge?
Eagle Ridge also had 10 condos and townhomes listed and 3 sold in October, against 4 houses listed. The Eagle Ridge condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Eagle Ridge home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

11 houses sold in Eagle Ridge with a median price of $1,305,000 (the middle half sold between $1,125,000 and $1,337,500), taking a median of 8 days to sell at 96.6% of the last list price; 18% sold above list. They had a median $566 per square foot, a median year built of 1983 and a median lot of 4,511 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Eagle Ridge?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 4 houses listed in Eagle Ridge. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Eagle Ridge a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Eagle Ridge had a sales ratio of 100% on only 4 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Eagle Ridge from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 12 houses sold in Eagle Ridge over those 5 months, out of 273 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Eagle Ridge?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Eagle Ridge sell for?
faq.a: 11 houses sold in Eagle Ridge between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,305,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Eagle Ridge?
faq.a: The median was 8 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.6% of the last list price (18% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
